To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a novel type of convolutional neural network, PointNet, is proposed that directly operates on 3D point clouds and provides a unified architecture that can be used for object classification, part labeling, and scene semantic parsing; 2) the network is highly efficient and achieves state of the art performance on par or better than existing methods on various tasks; 3) theoretical analysis is provided to understand the network and why it is robust to noise and corruption.
we have designed a simple yet effective neural network for point cloud data, and we have analyzed the network and provided some understanding of what it learns and why it is robust.
we design and evaluate a novel type of deep neural network that directly operates on point cloud and show that such network is effective for various tasks.

the following three aspects: 1) the network architecture; 2) the theoretical analysis; and 3) the applications.
the design of deep learning models that directly consume 3D geometric data in point cloud format.

we provide a novel and effective deep learning approach for processing point clouds.
